errors.evidence: The description incorrectly labels the color for 'Länder' as rosa (pink) instead of violett (violet).
The description does not explicitly state that the figure shows investments (Brutto- and Nettoanlageinvestitionen) of the Gebietskörperschaften in relation to GDP.
The description does not mention that the figure consists of two separate diagrams (left for Bruttoanlageinvestitionen, right for Nettoanlageinvestitionen).
The description does not distinguish between the left and right diagrams or their specific content (Brutto- vs. Nettoanlageinvestitionen).
The description omits the right diagram's focus on Nettoanlageinvestitionen.
The description does not explicitly state that the y-axis is labeled as '% des BIP'.
The description does not mention the high investment values in the early 1990s (over 3% of GDP) in the left diagram.
The description omits the decline in Bruttoanlageinvestitionen to about 2.5% by 2000.
The description does not mention the relatively stable development of Bruttoanlageinvestitionen between 2 and 3% after 2000.
The description omits that the Bruttoanlageinvestitionen end at just under 3% in the final years.
The description does not state that Nettoanlageinvestitionen are significantly lower than Bruttoanlageinvestitionen.
The description omits that Nettoanlageinvestitionen were around 0.7% of GDP in the early 1990s.
The description does not mention that Nettoanlageinvestitionen dipped into negative values.
The description omits that Nettoanlageinvestitionen mostly ranged between 0 and 0.5% after the 1990s.
The description does not mention the slight upward trend in Nettoinvestitionen since 2015.
The description omits that Nettoanlageinvestitionen never exceed 0.6%.
The description does not state that Nettoanlageinvestitionen end slightly above zero.
